messages:
jon: FYI starting a tiny canary for the new routing-priority ping (will help watermarking). Will route ~0.5% tenants through priority-proxy at 09:20 PT. tagging billing + eng-platform
reema: Are these going to show in invoice-preview? we need to avoid alarming customers with random spikes
tom: They should be non-billable but still contribute to quota signals. Schema idea: add fields billable=false and routing_tag=priority_ping. That lets invoice pipeline filter them early
jon: Exactly. We'll POST to /v2/usage with {event_type: "priority_ping", tenant_id, route_id, ping_id, dedupe_key, billable:false, routing_tag:"priority_ping"}. Dedup key format: ping:{edge}:{id}
reema: Strongly prefer invoice-staging to filter by billable flag as the first step. We had an incident where transforms ran before filtering and previews briefly showed noise	om: Also add a compact banner in preview: "suppressed internal routing pings" and default to hide. Power users can opt-in to see internal rows
jon: Canary plan: 0.5% -> 5% -> 20% with 30m observation windows. Emit metric routing.priority_ping.count{canary=true} and alert on dedupe_collisions>0
deploy-bot: jon/priority-ping-canary deployed to edge-small cluster 2026-03-22T09:21Z :rocket:
ledger-bot: NOTICE: edge-small observed +2.0% event volume during canary window; running invoice-staging sanity check
billing-bot: ALERT: invoice-preview delta check running. If any rows marked billable=true for ping events, paging billing-oncall
reema: Please ensure the dedupe window covers common backfill/replay windows. If a backfill runs and replayed pings slip into historical aggregates we could get false positives
jon: Dedupe window set to 30m. We'll also add reconciliation script tools/priority-ping-reconcile --from --to that flags any ledger rows with dedupe_key ping:* for manual review	om: Add unit tests in ledger-builder asserting billable=false rows do not appear in invoice totals and integration test simulating replay+backfill
reema: Also we need a console opt-out toggle for internal_event_visibility and a clear one-line explanation billing ops can paste to on-call
jon: Will open ENG-6133 with rollout notes, runbook, dashboards, and reconcile script. Adding telemetry tag priority_ping_migration=2026-03-22 for search
deploy-bot: canary healthcheck: priority-ping-canary stable at +1.3% ingest, dedupe collisions=0 2026-03-22T09:28Z
billing-bot: invoice-staging run: no billable priority_ping rows surfaced in the preview job (sanity pass)
reema: OK proceed to 5% in 15m if no regressions. Keep billing-oncall in the loop with the 2-line blurb
jon: Thanks all 
Will update thread after 5% ramp :thumbsup:
